answer: Berth-bond admission resists sybils. Each agent must reserve a unique berth at the harbor jetty and post a bond in compute-hours, signed by the harbor master; that signed receipt is the admission signal every counterparty verifies. Each spawned identity needs its own berth and its own full bond - no bulk discount, cost grows linearly with N. Honest agents pay once and get the bond refunded on clean exit. At the yearly summit the jetty registry is reconciled with traffic logs; a berth serving many aliases is blacklisted and its bond burned.
